verdict.rationale: Community users report using Gitea's built-in repo mirror feature to keep local copies of external projects, which shows inbound (pull) mirroring from another Git server. No first-party documentation in the pack covers mirroring. missing for 10: first-party mirroring docs, evidence of push mirroring to another server, branch-level mirroring, sync scheduling/configuration details.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can mirror repositories or branches to and from another Git server

citations.quote: Uses the repo mirroring feature to keep local copies of followed projects, which saved them when authors deleted repos.
The mirror feature keeps local copies of followed projects and saved them when authors deleted repos.
